name: @cbt/shared
description: Enum, tipe, dan schema validasi bersama API + Web CBT SMAN 1 Gorontalo

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist/esm')){const src=p.join('dist/esm',f);if(f.endsWith('.js'))fs.renameSync(src,src.replace(/\.js$/,'.mjs'));else if(f.endsWith('.js.map'))fs.renameSync(src,src.replace(/\.js\.map$/,'.mjs.map'))}"
